name: code-buddy
description: Local governance, prompt quality, context handoffs, and replayable task telemetry for Codex coding tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Governance and local analytics for Codex coding tasks.
interface.longDescription: Code Buddy captures Codex lifecycle events locally, enforces a developer-controlled preflight, reviews prompts, offers optional task decomposition and context handoffs, records privacy-first task telemetry, and rebuilds task lifecycles without a cloud service.
defaultPrompt: Use Code Buddy to review my next coding task.
Show Code Buddy status for this workspace.
Create a focused Code Buddy handoff for a fresh task.
